**Hawazan Reportedly Attacks Russian Bears by Accident**

A report sent to BCBN says Hawazan attacked the Russian Bears "on accident." The report says Hawazan's president was involved in the attack, and that the Russian Bears' central command is deciding how to react.

The screenshots sent with the report show strikes near a Russian Bears base on the map and a country list with a Hawazan-tagged country highlighted. They also show a player list with two players circled, one of whom is listed under the Hawazan country.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the report or the screenshots. Neither Hawazan nor the Russian Bears has issued an official statement.

We'll update this story when the Russian Bears decide how to respond.

**BREAKING: Hawazan Declares War on TPE**

Hawazan has declared war on TPE.

The declaration comes days after TPE announced it was withdrawing from the war against Hawazan, citing RUOT's withdrawal and the dissolution of its coalition. TPE said it was turning its attention to its own development.

BCBN doesn't yet have Hawazan's official statement or its reason for the declaration, and we haven't received a response from TPE. We'll update this story when we do.

**BREAKING: TPE Cuts All Ties With GIE**

TPE has officially cut all relations with the Greater Israeli Empire (GIE), effective immediately.

TPE says the decision comes from serious concerns about information leaks and inadequate security measures. It says these issues raise significant concerns about the security of TPE and its members, and that it can no longer keep relations with an organization whose security weaknesses threaten its own.

TPE says protecting its members, confidential information and internal operations remains a top priority.

GIE hasn't responded to the claims, and BCBN hasn't independently verified them. We'll update this story as more information comes in.

**S.D.U Says It Is at War With Hawazan and Warns of More Attacks**

A member of the Sovereign Defence Union (S.D.U) has told BCBN that S.D.U is at war with Hawazan. According to the member, Hawazan didn't have combat enabled when S.D.U tried to launch an attack, and he believes the faction was scared off.

He shared screenshots of the attempted attack and of a Hawazan member list showing members' wealth.

The S.D.U member also sent a warning to Hawazan: "And there are more attacks to come, be prepared, Hawazan!"

BCBN hasn't independently verified the account or the screenshots, and Hawazan hasn't responded. We'll update this story when it does.

**UDC and Coalition Vow to Keep Fighting Hawazan**

The United Defense Council (UDC) and its coalition partners say they will keep fighting Hawazan, in an official declaration dated October 28, 2026.

The UDC says the coalition remains united despite "ongoing challenges and the current situation," and that it won't back down. It calls Hawazan a danger to regional and international stability and says it will continue operations "until this threat is fully neutralized."

The declaration lists the coalition as the UDC, the Vollachian Empire, the Sovereign Defense Union, the Global Occult Coalition and the Army of Christ Our Lord, along with one other faction.

This comes as several factions, including RUOT, GAE, TPE and the United Pearl Cats, have withdrawn from the war.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the declaration, and Hawazan hasn't responded yet. We'll update this story when it does.

**USIIA Declares Neutrality in the Hawazan Conflict**

The United States International Intelligence Agency (USIIA) has announced it will stay neutral in the conflicts Hawazan is facing. Its official statement is dated October 28, 2026.

USIIA says joining the conflict would mean fighting more than five factions at once. It says that would cripple its alliances with the other factions it is allied with.

"We do not involve ourselves in the conflict," the statement says. It is signed by USIIA's Supreme Leader and the USFA Head Manager.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the statement. We'll update this story if USIIA's position changes.

**RUOT Co-Founder Steps Down After Backlash, Returns as Co-Founder**

The founder of the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) has stepped down as founder and returned to the faction as co-founder. According to reports, they stepped down because of hate received on the game's official Discord server and from the wider community.

This comes days after RUOT withdrew from the Hawazan war, dissolved its coalition and decided not to disband the faction.

BCBN hasn't received an official statement from RUOT about the change or who now holds the founder role. We'll update this story if one is released.

BCBN reminds everyone to keep criticism of factions respectful. Harassing players crosses the line.

**BREAKING: European Union Faction Permanently Deleted Over TOS Violations**

The European Union (EU) faction has been permanently deleted and dismantled, according to a final statement from the Office of the Secretary of the President of the EU.

The statement says the shutdown followed "clear and severe violations of the Terms of Service" by the faction's executive leadership, which it says left community authorities no choice but to enforce an irrevocable shutdown.

The Secretary says they are "deeply saddened and frustrated" by the outcome. They add that the President, the Secretary and the faction's administrative team spent extensive time and effort building and managing the EU, and that seeing months of work "rendered void" is a profound disappointment.

The EU had recently acted as a mediator in the Hawazan conflict, issuing a two-day ceasefire order between Hawazan and RUOT. It's unclear what happens to that process now.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the deletion or the details of the violations.

This is the European Union's final statement in BCBN. Now that the faction no longer exists, BCBN will no longer cover it.
